runs.note: docker run --cpus 2 with OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 and OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 (a CFS quota of 2 CPUs on a 10-core Apple Silicon laptop, thread counts set to the quota; DECISIONS.md 'BLAS and OpenMP oversubscribe under a Docker CPU quota'); `cpus` is the core count the container sees, not the quota. TZ=America/Bogota (the host's zone), so the date is the local one. `commit` passed in as MKTSTATS_COMMIT: git cannot reach the worktree's repository from the container. No data cache was mounted, so D1 (cell-048) downloaded Online Retail II from the parquet mirror inside the container (the cell took 1.4 s). Laptop shared with other build agents during the run.
